skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Moon under the Pines
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Moon under the Pines. Classic Yanese clothes, mixing tradition with modern craftsmanship. Wind Chimes leans against a tree, watching the moonlight shine in the water, her skirt like a shimmering ripple. What will you dream of tonight?
skins.usage: One of Wind Chimes's casual outfits.
skins.quote: With a letter home, the bell's toll resounds; Across a thousand li, two moons share the same sky.
